about: Voice-to-line benchmark for Line by Line. Synthetic test input: notes written by us in a mechanic's voice and spoken by macOS text-to-speech (voices and rates vary, half with shop-like noise). Labeled by us. Not real customers, not real mechanics. Expected = the price-list codes a service writer would add, with urgency; [] means no billable line (nothing found, or the work is not in the price list).

findings.note: Front pads are down to about two millimeters. Rotors look fine though.
Front discs are scored pretty bad and they're under minimum thickness. Pads still got some life left.
Cabin filter is packed with leaves. Not urgent, it can wait till the next oil change.
Serpentine belt has cracks all over it. I'd do it soon, before it lets go.
Battery tested weak, cold cranking amps are way under the rating. She might not start one of these mornings.
Coolant is brown and it smells burnt. I'd recommend a flush.
Rear brakes. Pads are at three mil and the rotors have a big lip on them. Do both on the rear.
Left outer tie rod has play in it, that's a safety thing. And it'll need an alignment after.
Engine air filter is dirty. Just a recommendation.
Driver side front tire has cords showing on the inside edge. Can't let it go out like that.
Picked up a screw in the right rear tire. It's in the tread, we can plug it.
Valve cover gasket is seeping oil onto the exhaust manifold, you can smell it burning.
Front struts are leaking, and the car keeps bouncing after bumps.
Brake fluid tested at four percent moisture. Flush it.
Wipers are streaking. Cheap fix, whenever they want.
Passenger headlight is out.
Hearing a hum from the front left that changes with speed. Wheel bearing has play.
A C is blowing warm. It's low on refrigerant, no visible leak.
Inner CV boot on the passenger side is torn and slinging grease, and the axle clicks on turns.
Sunroof drains are clogged, water's getting into the headliner.
Everything else looks good. Tires are fine, brakes are fine.
Check engine light is on, code P zero four two zero. Needs a diagnosis.
Sway bar end links are clunking over bumps, both sides.
Plugs are at a hundred and ten thousand miles. They're overdue.
Thermostat is stuck open, the temp gauge never comes up.
Water pump is weeping at the weep hole, there's coolant crust all over it.
Passenger side engine mount is torn. The engine rocks when I shift into drive.
Rotate the tires, the fronts are wearing faster.
Trans fluid is dark. Sixty thousand miles and it's never been changed.
Front pads and rotors both. It's metal on metal, grinding.
Left brake light is burned out.
Belt tensioner is chattering and the pulley wobbles.
